_purpose: Source-backed eligibility decisions for records with no reliable mature-cohort outcome; first-year nil opening does not preclude eligibility when a positive mature take-on is documented.
_status: Source decisions as recorded below; 1254/2022 is economically eligible but its gross outcome is unavailable pending reconciliation.

1254_2022.quote: PDF p6 (printed 6): 'The Syndicate was set up on 1 January 2022.' PDF p7 (printed 7): 'This is the first year of operation for the Syndicate, so it is not possible to compare its performance with previous years.' PDF p21 (printed 21): '2022 is the first year of trading for the Syndicate, so no prior year comparative disclosures are shown in this report.' PDF p41 (printed 41), note 13 'Claims outstanding', gross, £000: 'At 1 January 2022 -'; 'Inwards RITC of liabilities 75,257'; 'At 31 December 2022 55,574'; 'On 10th February 2022 and with effect from 1st January 2022, the Syndicate executed an inwards RITC for Syndicate 2689’s 2017, 2018 and 2019 years of account.' PDF p30 (printed 30) prints gross development by year of account 2017-2019 that 'includes the estimates made by Syndicate 2689, i.e. prior to the RITC of the portfolio': latest less previous -13,873 (2019), -10,369 (2018), -3,987 (2017), total -28,229, against the cedant's estimates; PDF p7: 'net reserve releases contributed a £4.7m profit'.
readings: review of 2 October 2026, R5-F1 and its second pass: p6 'The Syndicate was set up on 1 January 2022', p7 'This is the first year of operation for the Syndicate', p21 '2022 is the first year of trading' and p17 the member balance at 1 January 2022 as '-'; its reserves arrived by an inward RITC signed in February 2022 (p7)

stage-3 PC page check, 5 October 2026 (page images): the opening claims outstanding is nil (p41 'At 1 January 2022 -'); the RITC brought in 2689's 2017-2019 years with effect from 1 January 2022; the p30 table's -28.229 gross measures 2689's estimates, not reserves the syndicate held, and conflicts with the syndicate's own net release of 4.7m (p7)
29 October source comparison: gross triangle p30; gross claims paid p16; note 13 gross transferred liabilities and provision movement p41; gross premium by line p36.
1254_2022.decision: Eligible mature-cohort take-on with unreconciled gross outcome; retain outside the primary sample and count as eligible outcome unavailable pending source reconciliation.
1254_2022.lead: the review read p6 'The Syndicate was set up on 1 January 2022', p7 'This is the first year of operation for the Syndicate', p21 '2022 is the first year of trading' and p17 the member balance at 1 January 2022 as '-'; its reserves arrived by an inward RITC signed in February 2022 (p7)
1254_2022.reason: The 2017–2019 mature cohorts and GBP75.257m gross RITC liabilities transferred effective 1 January 2022 establish an eligible positive reserve base. The gross triangle changes sum to minus GBP28.229m (p30), while p16 and p41 give gross claims paid GBP22.748m and provision movement minus GBP27.481m, implying gross incurred minus GBP4.733m; the GBP23.496m difference is unreconciled. The p30 gross closing reserves sum to GBP55.276m versus GBP55.574m in note 13 (p41). FX and accounting treatment are not resolved, so no mature outcome is substituted.
